model_output.score_comment_short: Research work has useful detail, but marketing duties leave important questions.
model_output.score_comment_long: The research assistant role names the dataset, tool and study purpose. The marketing internship lists activities without explaining your contribution to each one. Clarifying the campaign claim and adding details to the internship bullets would improve the read.
model_output.score_plain: A reviewer can see early marketing and research experience, but may need more detail to judge your marketing responsibilities. The manager-level summary also needs support or a more accurate description.
model_output.first_impression: Your summary presents you as a marketing manager, while the listed credit union role is an internship. The research work is more concrete: cleaning data from 1,200 dairy farms shows the scale of that assignment.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "Helped with the member newsletter" does not say what you contributed, leaving your role in producing it unclear.
model_output.summary: Credit union marketing and agricultural research sit side by side on this resume. The listed roles point to early-career experience, with practical work in social media, survey data and reporting. Your summary claims campaign leadership from strategy to launch, but the internship bullets describe helping and supporting rather than explaining that leadership. A reviewer may struggle to reconcile those two accounts without an example.
strengths: The 15 literature summaries give a concrete picture of your research writing work.
Monthly expense reports for a 20-person firm show the setting and cadence of your finance assignment.
Tours for groups of up to 25 prospective students give public speaking a clear example.
gaps: The newsletter bullet doesn't identify the writing, editing or coordination you actually handled, so your contribution is difficult to distinguish.
The branch-event bullet doesn't explain which planning tasks you supported, leaving the extent of that work unclear.
The latest listed position ends in May 2024, so the resume doesn't show what you have done since then.

top_fixes.fix: In the summary, either add a supported example of the credit union campaign you led or revise the manager and leadership claim to match your actual responsibilities.
top_fixes.why: The current summary and internship description suggest different levels of responsibility.
